title: Video Downloader for Twitter X
summary: An easy to use video downloader for X (formerly Twitter). No log-in required.
description:
Tweeload offers a quick and easy way to download videos and GIFs from X (formerly Twitter). Tweeload makes it a breeze to download GIFs and videos from X (formerly Twitter).

Features:

- Easily download GIFs and videos from X.
- Share the videos to any app directly from the Tweeload app.
- Access all your downloaded videos right inside the app.
- Play downloaded videos right from the app.

How to use:

Method - 1 (Recommended)

1. Open the Tweet with the video that you want to download.
2. Tap on the Share icon below the tweet to open the share sheet.
2. Select Tweeload from the list of the apps to begin downloading the video.

Method - 2

1. Copy the link to the Tweet with the video that you want to download.
2. Open the Tweeload app and use the clipboard icon to paste the link.
3. Tap on Download to begin downloading the video inside the app.

Disclaimer

• Please ensure you have permission from the original owner before downloading videos or saving GIFs using Tweeload. 
• Tweeload isn’t affiliated or connected with Twitter. It’s a handy tool to help you download videos and GIFs for personal enjoyment.

We would love to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to us at contact@aculix.com for feedback or any queries.

Cheers! :)
